_comment: FALLBACK ONLY. budget_nudge.py counts turns from the agent's transcript (80% of maxTurns, then maxTurns - 3). These tool-call counts apply only when the agent has no maxTurns or its transcript cannot be found. Values: the drafted ones (system_improvement/02_briefing.md); a replay of 57 past runs showed they fit normal runs better than counts tied to maxTurns (system_improvement/07_enforcement.md, Results).
